Run both files and tests/test_pacing_links.py, tests/test_pacing_links_story.py. Never weaken an assertion; say what you changed in NOTES.txt.

set -eo pipefail
WORK=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/factory-31
mkdir -p "$WORK/out"
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
git reset -q
git add -A -- tests
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d | grep -vE '^(tests/story_source/test_cli_set\.py|tests/test_pacing_replay\.py)$' || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "files outside ownership staged: $bad"; exit 1; }
start=$(date +%s)
out=$(.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -rs -n 4 tests/story_source tests/test_pacing_replay.py tests/test_pacing_links.py tests/test_pacing_links_story.py tests/test_turn_telemetry.py 2>&1) || { echo "$out"; exit 1; }

case "$out" in *skipped*) echo "tests were skipped"; exit 1;; esac
took=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
echo "took $took s (budget 300 s)"
[ "$took" -le 300 ] || { echo "over the 300 s budget"; exit 1; }
PYFILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d | grep '\.py$' || true)
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff check $PYFILES
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check $PYFILES

test -s "$WORK/out/fix-tests.patch"
